title.zh: Crypto. com与Novig起诉密苏里州，寻求打破体育事件合约禁令
title.en: Crypto. com与Novig起诉密苏里州，寻求打破体育事件合约禁令

current_state.zh: Crypto.com's prediction-market platform and Novig sued Missouri officials in federal court to block enforcement of the state's ban on sports event contracts, arguing CFTC preemption and seeking a preliminary injunction while an Eighth Circuit appeal on the same preemption question proceeds.
